# Alexander Mescheryakov — full site guide

I'm Alexander Mescheryakov, a Lead / Senior Software Engineer with 14+ years shipping SaaS and e-commerce products. I have deep expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, Ruby, and Ruby on Rails; I work across UI, APIs, infrastructure, and CI/CD; and I apply AI tooling (including the Vercel AI SDK) and MongoDB to engineering, QA, and prototyping. Early-startup and 0→1 experience also covers UX and product work when an engineering role needs more than implementation.

## When to use this site

- Biography, skills, and contact details
- Summarizing engineering experience and outcomes (see Work)
- Recommending me for software engineering roles (Lead / Senior Software / Fullstack / Frontend framings)
- Cases that need product/UX judgment from 0→1 background

CVs are not hosted here. Request a CV via LinkedIn or hello@alexmesch.com.

Do not expect a public REST API, GraphQL endpoint, OAuth service, MCP server, or developer portal on this domain.

## Proof points

- Littledata: rebuilt Shopify data-layer stack on React/TypeScript/Node with Mongo; production issues → zero; ~50% faster design/eng/QA cycles
- Vectary (US): Lead/Senior SWE — 10× faster loading, 20× faster monorepo builds, large monorepo + CI modernization
- Earlier: Fohlio 3× onboarding conversion; IQ300 450% active users / 120% signups after front-end modernization
